generationInputs.prompt: A close-up shot on a black background features a large, brilliantly cut peach next to an eggplant and a syringe with a clear liquid inside, all encircled by a smoky mist. The peach is cut with many facets, reflecting light that makes it sparkle, especially at its top, where a bright white glint is visible. The eggplant is long and purple. The syringe is made of clear plastic with black markings for measurements and a light blue cap on the needle. The clear liquid inside the syringe appears to be at a level just below the 2ml mark. The smoky mist emanates from behind the peach, eggplant, and the syringe, creating a hazy halo effect around them. The black background emphasizes the glow of the peach and the white mist.
